sections.mood: 夜深、雨、還沒開口的酒吧；從窗外推進室內，最後落在琴鍵
小號進來；主角是那支小號與昏黃燈光，溫暖但寂寞
三重奏的另外兩位：低音提琴與刷子；節奏感但仍然慵懶
聚焦琴鍵、手與琴槌；內省、流動

黎明前、空場、燈一盞一盞熄

Shot on 35mm film, heavy film grain, almost monochrome: faded, strongly desaturated colors, only a faint hint of amber and cold teal, deep blacks, soft halation. Shallow depth of field, soft haze of smoke. Very slow, gentle camera movement, no fast cuts. Never show any face. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, plain unmarked signs, no neon lettering, no exit signs, no writing on windows or glass, no posters, no watermark, no subtitles.

The shot opens directly on this framing. Chairs turned upside down on small round tables, pale grey-blue dawn light falling across them from the side, dust floating in the light, the background soft and dark. Completely empty: no people anywhere in the frame, no customers, no musicians.

Slow lateral dolly.

Audio: near silence of an empty room at dawn, a few birds far outside, distant early traffic. No music, no speech, no voices.
